# Appnary

> Appnary builds Shopify apps. The app in development is Vigil, a security scanner for theme scripts, app embeds, leaked keys, and staff permission changes. Merchants can also run that scan from an AI agent over MCP. Vigil is not on the Shopify App Store yet. The waitlist stays open until Shopify approves the listing, and we invite people from that list.

## Company

- Appnary is a small team founded in Q1 2026.
- Founder: Harun R. Rayhan. Parent company: Binary Labs LLC.
- Contact: hello@appnary.com

## Vigil

- Status: in development. No install link until Shopify approves the listing.
- What it scans: published theme, app embeds, external scripts with a file or app name, leaked keys, staff permission history past 250 events.
- What a person can do: turn a flagged script off. The app does not uninstall other apps by itself in version 1.
- Agent scan: the same findings are available over MCP.
- Out of version 1: customer records and order contents.
- Waitlist: https://appnary.com/vigil#waitlist

## Later apps

- Sync: future. Store-to-store data first, then own-cloud and ERP as later modules. Waitlist: https://appnary.com/sync
- Backup: future, and last, because backup apps already have a large installed base. Waitlist: https://appnary.com/backup
- Public counts and the build order: https://appnary.com/interest
